description: Read published Facebook Page posts using a Page token resolved from the connected user. Returns exact PageID_PostID, message, permalink and media attachments. Use postId for an exact existing-post ad preflight. No Instagram media, comments, likes or insights are requested; this read alone does not establish advertising eligibility.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

postId.description: Exact PageID_PostID to read instead of the recent-post list; must belong to pageId.

name: meta_get_page_posts

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: meta get page posts
